priorityList: Use Shadow Blades when Shadow Dance and Secret Technique are both ready to be used.
Activate Shadow Dance when not in stealth, provided Secret Technique is ready or the Darkest Night buff is active.
Use Vanish to reset stealth and gain energy if you have 1 or fewer Combo Points.
Spend Combo Points when at maximum capacity (or 1 below max if Darkest Night is not active).
Use Secret Technique as your priority finisher during Shadow Dance or if Shadow Dance is not coming off cooldown soon.
Use Eviscerate as a finisher if the Darkest Night buff is active.
Use Coup de Grace as a finisher if Secret Technique is on cooldown or Shadow Dance is active.
Use Black Powder as a finisher if there are 3 or more targets (or 2 targets if Potent Powder is talented).
Use Shadowstrike to apply Deathstalker's Mark if it is missing and you are not in Darkest Night.
Use Shuriken Storm as your primary builder whenever 2 or more targets are present.
Use Shadowstrike if Darkest Night is active (on 4 or fewer targets) and Shadow Techniques stacks are high (5+).
Use Goremaw's Bite if you have a deficit of at least 3 Combo Points.
Sync racial combat buffs and offensive trinkets with Shadow Blades and Shadow Dance active periods.
If no other builders are applicable and in single-target situations within AoE, use Gloomblade or Backstab.
Use Arcane Torrent if Energy is low to help smooth out the rotation.
